product.name: Tably
product.description: Tably is reservation, waitlist and guest-messaging software for independent restaurants and cafés. It is for owner-operators who run the book themselves, the hosts and floor managers who seat guests and manage the walk-in line during service, and the diners who book, wait and come back.

personas.name: Independent restaurant owner
personas.description: Owner-operator of a small trattoria or café who chooses and pays for the booking tool and keeps the book full, reliable and affordable.

personas.name: Front-of-house lead
personas.description: Host or floor manager who runs the door and the floor during service: the walk-in line, the phone, table status, guest notes and staffing.

personas.name: Diner
personas.description: Guest who finds a place, books or queues for a table, and decides whether to come back.

hypotheses.name: H1 SMS included, not metered
hypotheses.statement: Owners prefer SMS reminders included in a flat subscription over per-message fees, and will pay a higher flat price for that.

hypotheses.name: H2 Link beats app
hypotheses.statement: Diners would rather book or join a waitlist through a link or QR code than download an app.

hypotheses.name: H3 Targeted deposits
hypotheses.statement: Deposits limited to large parties or prime slots cut no-shows without driving guests away.

hypotheses.name: H4 Capture DM bookings
hypotheses.statement: Restaurants that take bookings over Instagram DMs and WhatsApp would save meaningful daily time if each message became a booking in one step.

hypotheses.name: H5 Self-serve waitlist
hypotheses.statement: A self-serve QR or link waitlist that texts guests when their table is ready reduces walk-aways and empty-table time.

hypotheses.name: H6 Recognition drives return
hypotheses.statement: Diners return more often to restaurants that remember their preferences and allergies than to ones that treat them as strangers.
